name: macuse
description: Control native Mac apps — Calendar, Mail, Notes, Reminders, Messages — and drive any Mac app via Computer Use. Runs on-device. Requires the Macuse macOS app.

interface.shortDescription: AI control for native Mac apps and any Mac GUI
interface.longDescription: Macuse connects Codex to macOS: read and write Calendar, Mail, Notes, Reminders, and Messages through native domain tools, and drive any other Mac app through the Accessibility API without stealing your focus. Everything runs on-device with per-client OAuth and per-app permissions. Requires the Macuse macOS app from https://macuse.app. Note: write operations need a consent prompt that Codex currently auto-declines (openai/codex#18896) — read operations are unaffected.
defaultPrompt: What's on my calendar this week?
